title: Run a 12-hour AI scientist on your research data
summary: Edison Scientific's Kosmos reads about 1,500 papers per run; independent scientists judged 79.4% of its report statements accurate, and it highlights seven discoveries.
agent_role: Agents analyzed datasets, searched literature and drafted reports autonomously over a run; human scientists supplied the data and objective and evaluated the statements afterward.
outcome: About 200 agent rollouts, ~42,000 lines of code and ~1,500 papers read per run; independent scientists judged 79.4% of report statements accurate; seven showcased discoveries
what_they_did: Edison Scientific's team built Kosmos, an AI scientist. It takes an open-ended goal and a dataset and runs for up to 12 hours. One agent analyzes the data and another searches published research. They share findings in a common notebook, then repeat cycles of analysis, reading and forming new ideas. Kosmos writes reports that link every statement to its code or to a source paper. Scientists supplied data and goals and checked the results.
how_it_went: The paper reports about 200 agent runs, 42,000 lines of code and 1,500 papers read per run on average. Independent scientists found 79.4% of report statements accurate. Collaborators said a 20-cycle run equaled about 6 months of their own research time. It highlights seven discoveries: three match unpublished findings and four are new.
worth_knowing: About one in five report statements was not judged accurate. The links to code and papers matter because they let you trace and check each claim.
prompt: I have a dataset at [file or folder] and this research objective: [objective]. Work in cycles. In each cycle, run an analysis on the data, search the published literature for related findings, and update a running notes file that lists hypotheses, evidence for and against, and open questions. Save all analysis code. After [number] cycles, write a short report where every claim cites either the specific code output or a paper with a link. Flag which findings look new and which repeat known results. Show me your plan for the first cycle before starting.

curation.rationale: Launch seed collection, researched from search results.
